tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Relay a pre-signed order to the chain's Ophis orderbook. Pass the exact `order` object and `fullAppData` from build_order, plus your EIP-712 `signature` and `from` (owner). Returns the order UID on success and enrolls the owner for indexing, referral attribution, and trade rewards.

tools.name: get_integrator_earnings
tools.description: Look up routed volume, the Ophis base fee, and the integrator's own fee on CoW-hosted chains, by appCode (your widget appCode or SDK ophisReferrer code). Routed volume is reported in USD, split by chain and by Ophis-operated versus CoW-hosted chains. Read-only, keyless, cumulative.

tools.description: List configured EVM orderbook chains, split into `tradeable` (orderbook URL configured; only route get_quote/build_order to these) and `paused` (no configured orderbook URL, so those tools reject the chain). findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "validate_order" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Offline preflight for an order you built OUTSIDE build_order (no network call, no keys). Catches the documented silent-failure modes before you sign or submit: …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_chains, resolve_token · Private data: get_balances, get_portfolio, get_token_chart, expected_surplus, resolve_token · Public sink: submit_order, resolve_token, validate_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_chains, resolve_token · Private data: get_balances, get_portfolio, get_token_chart, expected_surplus, resolve_token · Public sink: submit_order, resolve_token, validate_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
